purpose: Express disbelief or introduce an unlikely possibility.
keywords: I never imagined I would meet you here.
Surely you have not forgotten the key?
I never thought it would turn to snow.
restrictions: May stand alone as a surprised response; often pairs with とは or ないだろう.
mistake: It expresses the speaker’s expectation, not objective impossibility.

segments.role: Express disbelief or introduce an unlikely possibility. まさか + statement / negative expectation
